verse.text: In the same way, you husbands must give honor to your wives. Treat your wife with understanding as you live together. She may be weaker than you are, but she is your equal partner in God's gift of new life. Treat her as you should so your prayers will not be hindered.

video.title: Showing Honor in Marriage (1 Peter 3:7) | Daily Devo Bible Study

reflection: Honoring your wife isn't about grand gestures every day — it's noticing when she's tired, asking about her day and actually listening, and treating her opinion as equal weight to your own. A house runs on how the husband treats the wife; kids catch that tone long before they understand the theology behind it. Small, consistent respect at home is some of the most powerful leadership a man will ever offer.
